parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paginated query. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of domain names on each page in a paginated query. Default value: **10**.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the default resource group is used.
